facts.text: Signed: India–Oman Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) — in presence of Narendra Modi and Sultan Haitham bin Tarik
facts.head: News

facts.text: Side: Oman (duty-free for India); Tariff lines: 98.08%; Trade covered: 99.38% of India's exports
facts.head: News

facts.text: Side: India (liberalised); Tariff lines: 77.79%; Trade covered: 94.81% of imports from Oman
facts.head: News

facts.text: Excluded by India: dairy, tea, coffee, rubber, tobacco, gold/silver bullion and jewellery, footwear, sports goods, base metal scrap
facts.head: News

facts.text: Mode 4: Intra-Corporate Transferees quota 20% → 50%; Contractual Service Suppliers stay 90 days → two years (+2 years extension)
facts.head: News

facts.text: FDI: 100% by Indian firms in major services sectors in Oman
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Oman's first bilateral trade agreement since 2006; India's second CEPA with a GCC country after UAE (2022)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Exports to Oman: $4.06 billion (0.93% of India's exports) — petroleum products 35.1%
facts.head: Trade 2024–25

facts.text: Imports from Oman: $6.5 billion — crude/petroleum gases 38%, fertilisers 16.3%
facts.head: Trade 2024–25

facts.text: Capital: Muscat; GCC member; oldest independent state in the Arab world
facts.head: Background — Oman

facts.text: Borders: Yemen, Saudi Arabia, UAE; Arabian Sea, Gulf of Oman
facts.head: Background — Oman

facts.text: Features: Rub al-Khali (Empty Quarter), Hajar Mountains (north), Dhofar Range (south)
facts.head: Background — Oman

facts.text: Exercise Naseem Al Bahr: India–Oman bilateral naval exercise since 1993; ⚠ Oman — first GCC country to hold bilateral naval exercise with India
facts.head: Background — Oman

facts.text: Concluded: December 2025 — in a record nine months; negotiated by a women-led team
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ India's first FTA with New Zealand
facts.head: News

facts.text: Side: New Zealand; Commitment: Zero duty on 100% of Indian exports
facts.head: News

facts.text: Side: India; Commitment: Tariff relief on 95% of NZ imports; 57% duty-free from day one
facts.head: News

facts.text: Side: FDI; Commitment: NZ commits $20 billion by 2030 (also reported as over 15 years), with clawback
facts.head: News

facts.text: Services: NZ's first-ever commitment on Ayurveda, yoga, traditional medicine (Health and Traditional Medicine Services Annex); mobility for IT professionals, engineers, yoga instructors, chefs, music teachers; 5,000 skilled professionals pathway
facts.head: News

facts.text: Students: work up to 20 hours/week; extended post-study work visas
facts.head: News

facts.text: Excluded by India: dairy (milk, cheese, butter, yogurt), onions, sugar, edible oils, spices, rubber
facts.head: News

facts.text: Agri cooperation: kiwifruit, apples, honey
facts.head: News

facts.text: Bilateral trade: $1.3 billion, to double in five years; NZ per capita income about $49,380
facts.head: Context

facts.text: Indian diaspora: about 5% of NZ population (about 3 lakh)
facts.head: Context

facts.text: NZ criticism: coalition partner called it "neither free nor fair"; Foreign Minister to vote against it in 2026
facts.head: Context

facts.text: India–US trade: $132 billion; 50% US tariffs; exports to US fell 12% (September), 8.5% (October)
facts.head: Context
